name: labs/dennis-van-gils__dvg_arduino_lock-in_amp
title: DvG Arduino lock-in amplifier (Alia_protocol_serial.Alia)
intro: DvG Arduino lock-in amplifier (Alia_protocol_serial.Alia), adapted from dennis-van-gils/dvg_arduino_lock-in_amp. It reads `ref_clipping_high`, `ref_clipping_low`, `adc_autocal_valid`, `adc_autocal_gaincorr` and 4 more; sets `ref_waveform`, `ref_freq`, `ref_offset`, `ref_amplitude` and 1 more; runs `start_acquisition` and `stop_acquisition`. `start_acquisition`: start the lock-in acquisition (the native on command); it takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
